name: SpaceStation Fund

terms.capitalCalls: Called over roughly three and a half years against a five-year investment period, in tranches as deals are done rather than on a fixed schedule.
terms.holdNote: Ten years from the Final Closing, extendable by the GP for two one-year periods at its discretion and further with Advisory Board consent. The investment period is five years.
terms.mgmtFeeNote: 2.00% of each Limited Partner’s COMMITMENT during the investment period, stepping down afterwards. On committed capital, not on income.

dealsNote: 13 companies held as at Sep 2026, expected past 40 by the time it distributes. A fund of 20+ is priced on the fund outcome table rather than the single-deal power law.
structure: An early-stage venture fund backing consumer brands and consumer technology across pre-seed, seed and Series A. It buys a portfolio, so it is priced on the fund outcome table rather than the single-deal power law, and its proceeds are spread over a sell-down window rather than a single exit date.
_about: Global deal facts only. Terms are identical for everyone who bought the same deal, so they live here rather than being retyped by each holder. Nothing personal is in this file: your commitment, funding dates, thesis and notes stay in your own tracker and never leave your machine.
source: Partnership Agreement and Subscription Agreement of SPVC Ventures Fund I, L.P. Holdings list from the sponsor H1 2026 LP report.
dealsInFundNote: The GP targets a final portfolio in the mid-to-high 30s, with about 20% of the fund reserved for follow-ons and no single position expected to exceed ~10%. Modelled at 37. Well above the 20-deal line, so it is priced as a fund rather than as a single company.
liquidityNote: The Partnership Agreement states a term and an investment period but no distribution schedule, so no GP-stated payout window is recorded and the model falls back to its default rule. Not invented.

feeDiscountLinkage: This commitment does double duty. A $250,000 commitment to the Fund earns Preferential SPV Terms on Spacestation-sponsored SPVs — a 5% management fee instead of 8%, carry unchanged at 20% — documented in the executed side letters for Spacestation 88 (Telly) and Spacestation 89 (ÆRTHLINGS). WHICH MAKES THE UNCALLED BALANCE MORE BINDING THAN IT LOOKS. The discount is contingent on the full $250,000 being subscribed at the Fund’s first closing and on remaining a non-defaulting partner. Failing either triggers a Make-Whole Amount on every SPV carrying that letter: the difference between 8%/20% and what was actually charged, deducted from distributions if unpaid. Defaulting on the fund would therefore cost the fund position and the fee terms on the SPVs beside it.
